newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Logic takes stake in RouterWare.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Logic takes stake in RouterWare.

text.p: Advanced Logic Research Inc, a maker of computer servers, said Tuesday it will acquire a minority interest in RouterWare Inc, a California maker of communications equipment, for $2.25 million.
The agreement also calls for the two companies to enter into joint development projects over the next three years with a combined spending limit of $1 million.

"ALR has been developing a communications device utilizing RouterWare software products for about a year and this investment will further strengthen the relationship between the two companies," Chairman Gene Lu said in a statement.
